title: Spectral symmetry fingerprints in equivariant representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.07410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Symmetry governs the organization of physical structures, while symmetry breaking reveals their transformations. In geometric deep learning, symmetry imposes rank constraints on equivariant representations, limiting the expressive capacity of equivariant graph neural networks (GNNs). Here we show that these constraints can instead be exploited: the singular-value spectra of equivariant representations provide a unified fingerprint of structural symmetry. We introduce spectral symmetry fingerprints (SymFP), which enable discrete point-group identification through rank-template matching and continuous symmetry analysis by quantifying spectral energy beyond target rank constraints. SymFP is orientation invariant and architecture agnostic, enabling a parameter-free GNN implementation. Its spectra can be reused across multiple target groups, and the resulting leakage scores satisfy subgroup monotonicity. Across synthetic structures, molecules

translated_title: 等变表示中的谱对称性指纹
translated_abstract: 对称性支配着物理结构的组织方式，而对称性破缺则揭示了它们的转变过程。在几何深度学习中，对称性对等变表示施加了秩约束，限制了等变图神经网络的表达能力。本文表明，这些约束反而可以被加以利用：等变表示的奇异值谱为结构对称性提供了一种统一的指纹。我们提出了谱对称性指纹，通过秩模板匹配实现离散点群识别，并通过量化超出目标秩约束的谱能量实现连续对称性分析。SymFP具有方向不变性和架构无关性，能够实现无参数的GNN实现。其谱可在多个目标群之间重复使用，且所得的泄漏分数满足子群单调性。在合成结构和分子（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出谱对称性指纹，将等变表示的奇异值谱作为结构对称性的统一指纹，实现了方向不变、架构无关、无参数的点群识别与连续对称性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Spectral Symmetry Fingerprints (SymFP), which exploit the singular-value spectra of equivariant representations as a unified fingerprint of structural symmetry, enabling orientation-invariant, architecture-agnostic, and parameter-free point-group identification and continuous symmetry analysis.
